modeling_decisions.identity_scope: The modeled feature is the compact Hull All-American Marching Band Complex garage/support building at Hull Field, not Hagle Hall. Purdue’s 2024 Alumni Band schedule identifies the Hull Complex garage separately from Hull Field; GIS FID 431 location and the aerial roof support this small-building match.
modeling_decisions.exterior: GIS-ring wall shell with a low masonry base, light gray upper cladding, five repeated field-facing vehicle/equipment service bays, a high window band, light low-slope roof, and parapets. Street View supports the low single-story form and repeated opening/window rhythm; bay count, dimensions and material are estimates because the facade is distant and no elevations were found.
modeling_decisions.interior: illustrative support space with open equipment handling, lockers, storage racks, benches and wash-area fixtures. Purdue sources document changing facilities and instrument/uniform storage for the TREC addition; exact room positions, dimensions, finishes and fixtures are not available and are schematic.
modeling_decisions.placement: no translation, rotation, or scale change to campus location; rebuilt footprint directly from GIS FID 431. West wall designated service edge because it faces adjacent Hull Field.
